wish: someone should make computer games for 4 year old children
spec:
Three no-reading games for small children: pop big colored shapes, find the matching shape, play eight colored note keys.
Tap a shape to burst it with a sound; in match, tap the one that looks like the big one; wrong taps only wiggle.
No losing, no timers, no ads, no links out; sounds are synthesized on the device and nothing is downloaded.
notes: Sound uses the Web Audio API, started on the first tap. Tallies remembered in localStorage.
